overview.headline: Balanced flight and how unbalanced forces create aircraft motion

keyPoints.point: Simplified flight studies one force direction while some other forces stay balanced
keyPoints.quote: some of the four forces acting on the aircraft are balanced by other forces

keyPoints.point: Steady level flight keeps weight balanced by lift and drag balanced by thrust
keyPoints.quote: the weight would be balanced by the lift and the drag would be balanced by the thrust

keyPoints.point: Unbalanced forces make the aircraft move in the direction of the greater force
keyPoints.quote: If the forces become unbalanced, the aircraft will move in the direction of the greater force.

keyPoints.point: Net force equals the difference between opposing forces such as lift minus weight and thrust minus drag
keyPoints.quote: The net force is the difference between the opposing forces; lift minus weight, or thrust minus drag.

keyTerms.gloss: gravitational pull balanced by lift in level flight
keyTerms.quote: the weight would be balanced by the lift and the drag would be balanced by the thrust
